research_question: Resolve Japanese SBIC East/Central/West identities, distinguish them from SBI Holdings, and determine what the Tokyo SBIC ChatGPT reference establishes.

findings.statement: Article 2 of the Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Companies Act, Act No. 101 of June 10, 1963, explicitly names exactly three companies: Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd., with offices in Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka.

findings.legal_name: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
findings.shareholder_description: Local governments in 18 prefectures, chambers of commerce, financial institutions and business companies.
findings.service_region: Shizuoka, Nagano and Niigata eastward, covering 18 prefectures and others.

findings.legal_name: Nagoya Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
findings.service_region: Aichi, Gifu, Mie, Toyama and Ishikawa.

findings.legal_name: Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
findings.service_region: Fukui, Shiga, Nara, Wakayama and 20 other prefectures westward.

findings.statement: SBI Holdings, Inc. is a separate holding company established July 8, 1999, whose stated principal business is control and management of SBI Group companies through share ownership. The three SBIC companies were established in 1963 under a separate statute; their official profiles identify one another as sister companies. The reviewed primary evidence does not establish that any of the three SBIC companies is a subsidiary or affiliate of SBI Holdings.
limits: Do not infer corporate affiliation from the similar SBI/SBIC lettering.
This finding distinguishes the entities; it does not claim that no commercial relationship of any kind could ever exist without a separate agreement search.

findings.statement: Tokyo SBIC East Japan listed a two-day generative-AI and machine-learning training course for June 12–13, 2025. Its curriculum explicitly included ChatGPT use, Copilot, prompt/business use, APIs and no-code/low-code implementation. The fee and eligibility text says it was for investee companies and not generally open to other companies.
limits: This is a training event, not evidence of an OpenAI partnership, procurement contract, joint product, model deployment or commercial investment relationship.

findings.statement: The 2026 Seongnam International Biohealthcare Convention also uses the acronym SBIC, but it is unrelated to the Japanese three-company statutory group.

中小企業投資育成株式会社法
制定：昭和３８年６月１０日法律第１０１号
最終改正：平成２６年６月２７日法律第　９１号
（会社の目的）
第１条
中小企業投資育成株式会社は、中小企業の自己資本の充実を促進し、その健全な成長発展を図るため、中小企業に対する投資等の事業を行なうことを目的とする株式会社とする。
（会社の数及び事務所）
第２条
中小企業投資育成株式会社（以下「会社」という。）は、東京中小企業投資育成株式会社、名古屋中小企業投資育成株式会社及び大阪中小企業投資育成株式会社とし、それぞれ本店を東京都、名古屋市及び大阪市に置く。
